## kb_to_source

Sentence sweep of the three hubs, three computation documents, fifteen factor documents and the base documents above: every normative claim has a source, except **KB-1** below. Cross-problem operational guidance: none (each tool name appears only in its own invocation block). Opening world state written as policy fact: none. Derivations checked as provable (e.g. "a Life-of-Tread certificate bought on the Crestline card or charged to a fleet account among them" stays on rule 4; "An alignment plan that has expired or been cancelled is not an active plan"; "The administration fee is a flat amount per certificate").

- **KB-1 (rewrite).** `out_of_area_tire_replacement_reimbursement_5ecd9541`, Scope paragraph: "An out-of-area replacement whose tire was surrendered or whose receipt falls short of it, **and every out-of-area repair and tow, remain under the base reimbursement terms**". Source (`hazard_ext_outside_replacement_reimbursement.rule`): the base out-of-area condition holds for every claim "other than the out-of-area replacement this policy handles, an out-of-area repair whose receipt covers its repair allowance and an out-of-area tow whose receipt covers its tow allowance", which "state their own out-of-area condition"; T3/T5 are retired for those repairs and tows by their own policies. In this corpus "remain(s) under the base reimbursement terms" is the phrase the repair and tow hubs use for claims outside any extended scope, so the sentence asserts that in-scope repairs and tows are reimbursed under T1/T3/T5, contradicting `out_of_area_tire_repair_reimbursement_57322ac7` and `out_of_area_tow_reimbursement_3e931f3d`. Class sweep ("keeps/remains under the base terms" scope sentences): `store_replacement_authorization_c1bc485b`, `counter_replacement_posting_5e64eb76`, `out_of_area_tire_repair_reimbursement_57322ac7`, `out_of_area_tow_reimbursement_3e931f3d`, `life_of_tread_certificate_cancellation_7350be66`, `certificate_cancellation_and_refund_terms_5b60cc48` — all correct; KB-1 is the only member. Effect on task 0: none on any scored value (no repair or tow in this world).
